state_scout.command_template: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 nice -n 19 python -m python.benchmark_counterfactual universal-routed.pt --profile classic_generic_2022 --generator procedural_v1 --players 5 --environments 4 --updates 320 --label-stride 8 --candidate-count 3 --training-seat 4 {horizon} --seed 4000000 --device cpu --width 19 --height 15 --action-limit 2400 --land-density-per-million 650000 --tree-density-per-million 150000

paired_single_intervention.command_template: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 nice -n 19 python -m python.evaluate_counterfactual universal-routed.pt --profile classic_generic_2022 --generator procedural_v1 --players 5 --environments {games} --model-seat 4 --candidate-count 3 --rollout-horizon 96 --intervention-round 0 --seed {seed} --device cpu --width 19 --height 15 --action-limit 2400 --land-density-per-million 650000 --tree-density-per-million 150000
paired_single_intervention.selection_rule: at the first seat-4 decision, evaluate the policy top three legal actions through 96 further atomic actions under the frozen routed policy; prefer a known root win over a censored rollout, then larger root territory, breaking ties in favor of the direct policy; use the chosen action once and play the rest of the game with the frozen policy

decision: native exact-state forking and censored rollout instrumentation accepted; one-decision 96-action territory lookahead rejected as a strength claim and not promoted to a model or rating
conclusion: One-step counterfactuals expose many short-horizon territory differences, but all 57 complete continuations on four sampled maps still lost for seat 4. A fresh 64-map intervention gate yielded only three paired improvements versus two regressions, p=1.0. This is no evidence of a useful universal amplifier; whole-turn decisions or outcome-grounded multi-action credit require a separate tested hypothesis.
